title: CO open facing a BTN 3-bet
keyIdea: The button 3-bets wide against a CO open, but you'll be out of position. Continue with good hands; fold the bottom of your opening range.

actions.call: JJ-66, AQs-ATs, KQs-KTs, QJs, JTs, T9s, AQo

notes.A5s: A classic bluff raise: the ace blocks AA/AK, and it can still make a straight or the nut flush.
